editorial.blurb: A beloved Uptown Thai spot where a husband-and-wife team craft authentic curries and noodles with freshly ground curry pastes and genuine flavor balance.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Panang curry or green curry and specify your spice level—reviewers rave about the heat in the papaya salad, so clarify if you want it milder. Call ahead if customizing dishes to ensure proper portions.
